name: Enshrined: Sword of Fates
source:
You are a seasoned adventurer in pursuit of the fabled Sword of Cietri, a mystical blade that only appears once every 100 years for just 24 hours. At the penultimate moment of success, a sudden mysterious voice informs you that the sword’s power can only be unlocked by "joining with another in body and spirit…"

...and your only choices are three strangers who, by a convergence of fates, were also seeking the fabled blade, and moments ago were just trying to kill you. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3835610/Enshrined_Sword_of_Fates/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是一位经验丰富的冒险家，正在追寻传说中的西特里之剑，这把神秘的剑每100年才出现一次，持续时间仅为24小时。就在成功的倒数第二个时刻，突然有神秘的声音告诉你，只有“身体和精神与他人结合……”才能解锁剑的力量。

…而你唯一的选择是三个陌生人，由于命运的交汇，他们也在寻找传说中的剑，而不久前还试图杀死你。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3835610/Enshrined_Sword_of_Fates/]Steam[/url]]
